stories.text: 🪦 FRESH OBITUARY: Joe's Scary Team has been laid to rest (14.72 pts short). Read it on the Death Watch tab, and bring tissues.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy vs Mr. Action Jackson, playoff odds win/loss: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy 56%/16%, Mr. Action Jackson 76%/40%.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: Claremont In Yo Stace! vs The Mahomies. Playoff odds with a win / loss: Claremont In Yo Stace! 86% / 55%, The Mahomies 34% / 5.7%.
✅ CLINCHED: Brock You Like a Hurricane has locked up the #1 seed and a bye.
🏈 100-YARD RUSH: Ruffing the Passer ripped off a 26-yard run last week, 29% → 55% playoff odds. Hit the hole and never looked back.
🔮 Kyle Tucker vs 49er Faith-Fool is tightening — the projected margin shrank to 2.37 pts.

🤝 HINDSIGHT DEPT.: 5 weeks ago we said The Mahomies should get Bo Nix and Parker Washington from Ramosverse. Since: Bo Nix and Parker Washington 138.84 pts, Devaughn Vele and Jeremiyah Love 40.40 pts.
🎯 TWO WINS: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy: 66% playoff odds with 2 wins this week, 14% with none (now 43%).
📺 Up next, Wednesday 8 PM (GB @ LAR): Williams and Rams D/ST for TDsMaGee; Golden for The Mahomies; Love for Ruffing the Passer.
⚠️ ELIMINATION WATCH: Kyle Tucker could be officially out of the race for a playoff spot as soon as next week.
🥶 Kirbo Crushers has dropped 3 straight. Can they snap it against Gibb it to Me Baby?
📈 Stock rising: Brock You Like a Hurricane has its ESPN projection trending up.
📈 Ruffing the Passer was down to 0.5% against Kirbo Crushers — and won.
💓 Brock You Like a Hurricane outlasted 49er Faith-Fool after the favorite flipped 9 times.
